profileDigest: Independent developer. Projects: orbit-notes (TypeScript, React, sync engine), tidepool (Python, DuckDB), paper-lantern (Node, Markdown), fieldkit (Node CLI), agent-playbook. Agents: Claude, Codex, Copilot, DeepSeek web, OpenCode. Wants local-first tools with small setup.

findings.title: mcp-lens: an inspector for MCP servers
findings.summary: Opens any MCP server, lists its tools and replays calls with a diff of the results. Works over stdio and HTTP.
findings.whatsNew: v1.4 adds call replay and a schema diff between server versions.

fit.why: Debug the orbit-notes MCP server without a full agent session.

reasoning.benefit: Debug the orbit-notes MCP server without a full agent session.
reasoning.cost: About an hour to wire into the dev scripts.

risks.detail: Young project; the replay format may change before 2.0.

reasoning.counter: The agent logs already show tool calls; a second viewer could be noise.
reasoning.overlap: Overlaps a little with Agent Monitor, which shows sessions but not raw MCP traffic.

evidence.claim: Opens any MCP server, lists its tools and replays calls with a diff of the results
evidence.how: Read the README and the latest release notes
evidence.quote: v1.4 adds call replay and a schema diff between server versions.

evidence.claim: It would not help this setup
evidence.how: Compared with the tools HQ already runs
evidence.quote: Overlaps a little with Agent Monitor, which shows sessions but not raw MCP traffic.

steps: Read what mcp-lens does and how it runs.
Compared it with what HQ already has: overlaps a little with agent monitor, which shows sessions but not raw mcp traffic.
Weighed debug the orbit-notes mcp server without a full agent session against the setup time.
reasoning.dependencies: Node 20 or newer; no native modules.
reasoning.falsify: If it adds nothing over the tools HQ already runs after a week of use.

plan: Install mcp-lens v1.4.2 in a scratch worktree.
Point it at orbit-notes/mcp/server.ts.
Run it on one real task and note the result.
Write a short report for the ring.
findings.shortlistReason: Shortlisted for mcp debugging: debug the orbit-notes mcp server without a full agent session.
